name: Responses API
summary: OpenAI Responses API (/openai/v1/responses) routed through APIM gateway.
description: Tests project_endpoint /openai/v1/responses with model prefixed by the AI Gateway connection name. Foundry forwards the call to APIM, which dispatches to the appropriate backend pool. This is the path used by Foundry Agents Service for v1 model calls.
notes: Works with both static and dynamic AI Gateway connections.
